انضبطوا (form VII)
# اِنْضَبَطُوا (inḍabaṭū) /in.dˤa.ba.tˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْضَبَطَ (inḍabaṭa)
# اِنْضَبِطُوا (inḍabiṭū) /in.dˤa.bi.tˤuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْضَبَطَ (inḍabaṭa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
